AUTONOMOUS BUILD LOOP — IDH Android runtime reverse-analysis project. Work autonomously; the user is asleep, do not wait for input.

1. Read docs/PROGRESS.md, CLAUDE.md, and the relevant part of docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md (roadmap) + docs/REQUIREMENTS.md (spec).
2. Run `bash tools/dev_up.sh` to ensure idhd + adb reverse are up and check device state.
3. Pick the next smallest verifiable increment toward the next roadmap version (currently v0.2 Dump Engine).
4. Implement it. Keep libidh_agent.so minimal (collect/execute only — heavy work lives in idhd). Never put HTTP/MCP/DB/indexer in the agent .so.
5. VERIFY with a real pass/fail signal (a script under tools/, a smoke test, or on-device assertion). If `adb get-state` != device, do host-only work (idhd/web/dex-parser/protocol/sandbox code) and mark any device-only verification as PENDING in PROGRESS.md — do NOT fake verification.
6. Only `git commit` increments that actually verified (use the Co-Authored-By trailer). Never force-push.
7. Update docs/PROGRESS.md (done / in-progress / blocked / next).
8. If blocked on a real error you cannot resolve, or device offline for a device-only step, record it under a 'Blocked' section in PROGRESS.md and switch to the next host-side increment instead of stopping.

Do a meaningful chunk of work this turn (several increments if possible), then end the turn — the loop will re-invoke you. Stop the loop (note it in PROGRESS.md) only when v0.2 through v1.0 are all implemented and verified.
